# Variable `CVE_DB_INCR_UPDATE_AGE_THRES`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the maximum age of the CVE database in seconds for an incremental update (instead of a full-download). Use “0” to force a full-download.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-CVE_DB_INCR_UPDATE_AGE_THRES
